issues.description: Method name/signature mismatch for feeding the animals: the problem statement and solution define the Farm API as feedAllAnimals(), but the template's Main (commented test code) calls farm.feed(). This inconsistency can confuse students who try to uncomment and run the provided Main: they will get a compilation error or be unsure which method name to implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template Main consistent with the specification and solution. Update the commented test code in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (and farm.addAnimal(...) as needed) instead of farm.feed(), or provide a forwarding method farm.feed() in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals(). Prefer updating Main to use feedAllAnimals() to match the UML and solution API.

issues.description: Signature mismatch for singFarmSongVerse in the template Farm: the UML and solution expect singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) but the template's private method has the parameter commented out (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)). This creates an inconsistency between the described design and the template stub and can confuse students when they try to implement singFarmSong() and call singFarmSongVerse(animal).
issues.suggested_fix: Restore the intended parameter in the template: change the method signature in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java to private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) so it matches the UML/specification and the solution. This will avoid confusion when students implement singFarmSong() and call the helper with an Animal argument.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution use the method name feedAllAnimals() for the action that feeds every animal, but the template's Main.java example calls farm.feed(). This refers to the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals) but with a different identifier. Students copying the example from the template Main may try to call farm.feed() and encounter a missing-method/compile error or be confused about which method to implement, breaking the direct mapping from the task description to the provided starter code.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the template example with the problem statement and solution by replacing the call to farm.feed() in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java with farm.feedAllAnimals(). Alternatively, add a small delegating method public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); } to the template Farm class so both names are supported, but the preferred fix is to use feedAllAnimals() in the template to match the specification and solution.
